provenance_note: Experiments and pricing thresholds are proposed management decision rules; only TECH-01 has observed local results

experiments.name: Проблемные интервью primary segment
recruitment_requirements: Own current/recent agent or procurement automation workflow
Concrete last case or inspectable workflow artifact
No generic AI enthusiasm counted as qualified problem
procedure: Obtain consent for notes; recording only with separate consent
Ask about last concrete case, workaround, frequency, consequences and owner
Separate observations/quotes from interpretation
Code independent organisations, do not double count multiple people from same company
Keep bank/API/IAM expert requirements separate from buyer willingness to pay

decision_gate.management_threshold: Within 7 primary interviews: 4 distinct recent case IDs from at least 3 independent organisations, plus 2 specific evaluation next steps from different organisations. Do not double count the same case or organisation.
decision_gate.note: Working team decision rule, not market share or promised outcome

experiments.name: Независимый SDK onboarding
experiments.scope: One test organisation, one owner/agent/mandate, local provider; no Concierge
procedure: Give repo/docs and bounded task before showing a live walkthrough
Start clock at task brief and available prerequisites
Participant registers agent/mandate, creates own intent and handles ASK
Participant submits one-use grant through separate executor and fetches result
Record interventions, blockers and completion time; debrief on own alternative
experiments.success_measure: Both participants complete defined task without author taking control; first own decision target within one working day, not measured yet
experiments.failure_decision: Fix onboarding/scope before adding product screens

experiments.name: Baseline ручного процесса и controlled workflow comparison
procedure: Select one bounded repetitive workflow with process owner
Agree definitions and cases before testing
Record current approval, exception investigation and engineering support time
Run comparable synthetic cases through AgentPass and classify exceptions
Keep unsafe/ambiguous outcomes visible; do not select only easy successes
metrics: engineering hours to integrate and maintain
unknown recovery time and unresolved count
experiments.threshold: Agree a minimum useful time/cost improvement with the actual owner before running; no invented percentage

experiments.name: Два отдельных pricing discovery офера

offers.status: older hypothesis; not actual tariff or validated willingness to pay
separate scenario; scope and SLA not yet agreed

procedure: First confirm problem and budget owner
Compare offer scope to own make-or-buy alternative
Ask about purchase process and required evidence, not whether price sounds nice
Record actual next step, objections, budget approval and contract/payment status separately
Do not convert USD and RUB or combine segments without explicit currency and service scope assumptions
strong_evidence: approved budget plus defined procurement action

experiments.name: Контролируемый concurrency / replay / revoke drill
experiments.interpretation: Local atomic budget / replay / revocation behaviour observed on actual API+worker+PostgreSQL
experiments.timing_limitation: Client timing includes HTTP setup and lock waiting under burst; do not call it Policy Engine latency

experiments.name: Совместная внешняя test integration
experiments.scope: One agreed TEST provider, one trusted merchant/order source, synthetic data only
procedure: Agree trust boundary, IAM, owner and incident process
Confirm exact provider idempotency and callback/refetch semantics
Test pending, success, cancel, unknown timeout and reconciliation with real test credentials
Verify frozen intent binding and provider evidence; keep unresolved cases quarantined
Run independent review before any expanded deployment
experiments.acceptance: No success without authenticated matching provider evidence, no duplicate payment per grant, preserved budget on unknown and agreed operator recovery process

metrics.name: Qualified problem evidence
metrics.numerator: Independent qualified organisations with concrete recent case + workaround + consequence owner
metrics.denominator: All independent qualified organisations interviewed in same primary segment

metrics.name: Activation
metrics.source: integration_started + integration_activated events and task log

metrics.name: Initial ASK share
metrics.numerator: COUNT DISTINCT intent_id WHERE policy_evaluations.stage='initial' AND decision='ASK'

metrics.name: Approval latency
metrics.definition: resolved_at minus created_at for approved/rejected approvals; show unresolved pending separately

metrics.name: Unknown incidence
metrics.numerator: Distinct execution with any audit event execution.unknown in cohort
metrics.denominator: Distinct execution with first execution.dispatch_claimed in cohort
metrics.source: audit_events with execution resource_id; do not use only current status

metrics.name: Trace completeness
metrics.numerator: Succeeded execution with matching snapshot/grant, provider ID/status, transaction and verification evidence
metrics.denominator: All succeeded execution in same environment/cohort
metrics.status: PARTIAL: current code validates test/hash; independent immutable verification record not fully persisted

metrics.name: API decision latency
metrics.definition: p50/p95/p99 request_logs.duration_ms for POST /v1/intents, fixed environment/concurrency, separate HTTP status classes

metrics.name: Commercial conversion
metrics.denominator: Qualified primary-segment opportunities in defined cohort

metrics.name: Safety guardrails
metrics.definition: Unauthorised execution count, duplicate provider purchase per grant count, false success count; all must remain zero in agreed test set
